shots.name: 61-onboarding-aws-ready
shots.description: Onboarding, AWS selected: provider rail with per-provider status lines, profile list (first row selected), SSO badges (signed out, expires in 6 h, couldn't check sign-in), Sign in with SSO button, footer with credentials note and Open button.

shots.name: 62-onboarding-aws-detecting
shots.description: AWS, looking for profiles: skeleton rows and a spinner line; rail says Looking…; Cancel in the footer.

shots.name: 63-onboarding-aws-nothing-found
shots.description: AWS, no profiles in ~/.aws/config: empty state with a copyable 'aws configure sso' command, Check again, Choose config folder…, and an Explore demo fleet link.

shots.name: 64-onboarding-aws-sso-sign-in
shots.description: AWS SSO sign-in inline in the pane (AuthStep::DeviceCode): device code, start URL and expiry, Open browser again, Copy code, waiting spinner; rail says Signing in….

shots.name: 65-onboarding-aws-region-picker
shots.description: AWS scope step after opening a profile: region checklist with last-known instance counts, Select all, Back to profiles, 'n of 6 selected' and Load n regions.

shots.name: 66-onboarding-aws-config-error
shots.description: AWS config file unreadable: parse error with file and line, Check again, Open file, Copy error; rail shows a red Config error dot.

shots.name: 67-onboarding-gcp-ready
shots.description: Google Cloud selected: signed-in account and ADC file path above the list, project rows (name, project id, zones last used), Open.

shots.name: 68-onboarding-gcp-no-adc
shots.description: Google Cloud with no Application Default Credentials: copyable 'gcloud auth application-default login', Check again, Choose config folder…, where CloudDeck looked.

shots.name: 69-onboarding-gcp-service-account
shots.description: Google Cloud ADC file is a service_account key: warning that it is not supported yet and the user-login command.

shots.name: 6a-onboarding-gcp-zone-picker
shots.description: Google Cloud scope step: zone tree with regions as parents (checked, mixed, unchecked), zone children indented, 'n of m zones' per region, Load n zones.

shots.name: 6b-onboarding-extension-ready
shots.description: Extension provider (Fake Cloud): connections from connections(), one signed out; Connect… button in the header.

shots.name: 6c-onboarding-extension-methods
shots.description: Extension sign-in, choose method: one card per AuthMethod (label, description).

shots.name: 6d-onboarding-extension-prompt
shots.description: Extension sign-in, AuthStep::Prompt: generated form, secret field masked, hint line, Connect.

shots.name: 6e-onboarding-extension-browser
shots.description: Extension sign-in, AuthStep::OpenUrl: Continue in your browser, waiting spinner, Open again.

shots.name: 6f-onboarding-extension-disabled
shots.description: Installed but disabled extension: greyed rail item, pane explains it is not enabled, Manage extensions….

shots.name: 6g-onboarding-demo
shots.description: Demo fleet selected: demo card, Open demo fleet, DEMO tag note.

shots.name: 6h-onboarding-add-provider
shots.description: Add provider…: extensions explanation, copyable install command, Manage extensions….

shots.name: 6i-onboarding-opening
shots.description: After Load/Open: confirmation that the main window opens and onboarding closes for good.

shots.name: 6j-onboarding-aws-ready-dark
shots.description: Dark theme, same state as 61.

shots.name: 6k-onboarding-gcp-zone-picker-dark
shots.description: Dark theme, same state as 6a.

shots.name: 6m-onboarding-detail-rail
shots.description: Detail, 2x: the provider rail. Brand block, PROVIDERS header, provider rows (30px tile, name 13/600, status line 11 with coloured dot), selected and disabled rows, dashed Add provider…, Manage extensions… at the bottom.

shots.name: 6n-onboarding-detail-connection-rows
shots.description: Detail, 2x: connection rows. 34px initials badge (accent when selected), name 13/600, detail 11 dim, right-aligned auth status with dot and SSO pill.
